name: Farmer carry
summary: Heavy weights in each hand, walk tall for distance or time.
setup: Pick up a heavy weight in each hand. Stand tall, shoulders back, and walk with short, steady steps for the distance or time.
why: Walking takes you out of frame. Logged by hand.

faults.label: Leaning to one side
faults.tip: Brace the sides of the trunk; the weights should not tip you.

faults.label: Shoulders creeping up
faults.tip: Let the weight hang from a set shoulder rather than hanging off the neck.

faults.label: Shoulders shrugging
faults.tip: Let the arms hang long from a packed shoulder.

faults.label: Walking fast
faults.tip: Rushing wastes the bracing that makes this a core exercise.

guide.cannotSee: You — the exercise walks out of frame.
